## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
  return server
}
if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) await start()

## Objective
- Build and polish a complete, playable browser game inspired by “Bloons tower defence 5”, with no clarifying questions.
- Deliver tower defense gameplay with waves, towers, upgrades, touch support, and a polished visual presentation.

## Requirements
- Build a complete playable game now; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- User named the game “Bloons tower defence 5”; implementation is an original homage titled “Bloon Blitz TD”.
- Must support mobile phones/tablets with usable touch controls and responsive layouts.
- No external assets/dependencies preferred; game uses generated Canvas art and Web Audio.

## Decisions
- Built original monkey/bloon art and branding rather than copying Bloons TD assets.
- Vanilla ES modules + Canvas 2D, served as static HTML.
- Implemented 10 towers with 3 upgrades each, 4 targeting modes, 50 authored waves + freeplay, MOAB/BFB bosses, farm economy, auto-start, speed controls, pause, sound, help and result modals.
- Map is “Monkey Meadow” with a 1200×760 logical playfield, winding path, responsive canvas scaling.

## Work State
### Completed
- Core files created: `index.html`, `styles.css`, `js/data.js`, `js/path.js`, `js/audio.js`, `js/game.js`.
- Implemented gameplay: path sampling, tower placement validation, targeting, projectiles, splash, ice/glue, layered bloon splitting, cash/lives, wave spawning, completion, defeat/victory, freeplay, upgrades, selling, persistence.
- Implemented full HUD, shop, tower inspector, wave preview, toast/banner, help and result dialogs.
- Implemented sound synthesis and responsive CSS for desktop, portrait mobile, and landscape phone layouts.
- Server running in tmux session `bloon-dev` at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Playwright Chromium installed successfully.
- Desktop visual verification done: game centered, shop/upgrade UI working, tower placement and wave combat working (`pops` increased, cash spent/earned).
- Mobile portrait layout issues identified (large dark letterbox bands, cramped shop); CSS has just been rewritten to use exact 1200:760 board aspect ratio and a larger vertical shop grid, but this rewrite has not yet been browser-verified.

### Active
- Verify the just-applied mobile CSS rewrite and landscape layout in Playwright.
- Validate round completion, auto-start transition, upgrades, selling, defeat/victory dialogs, and freeplay.
- Fix remaining UI polish issues (board tip text, mobile scale/readability).

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Run `node --check js/game.js` (already passes after latest patch) and reload `http://localhost:3002`.
2. Screenshot desktop at 1440×900 and mobile at 390×844; inspect new portrait layout.
3. Test tower placement, start wave, wait for wave completion, confirm `phase` becomes `between` and auto-start countdown works.
4. Test upgrade purchase, targeting cycle, sell, help modal pause/resume, and result dialog via debug API.
5. Add favicon to eliminate last console 404 (`favicon.ico`).
6. Fix stale board tip after placing tower if still present; verify `placeTower()` now calls `selectTower(tower)`.
7. Test landscape phone viewport (e.g. 844×390).
8. Finalize with a concise note of assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: Main runtime, simulation, rendering, input, UI, debug API.
- `js/data.js`: Tower definitions, bloon definitions, 50 waves, difficulty helpers.
- `js/path.js`: Chaikin-smoothed path, distance sampling, placement distance checks.
- `js/audio.js`: Synthesized sound effects.
- `index.html`: Markup, icon sprite, HUD/shop/tower/help/result structure.
- `styles.css`: Desktop/mobile/landscape layout, panels, cards, modals.
- `screenshots/desktop-1.png` … `desktop-5.png`: Visual verification captures.
- `screenshots/mobile-1.png`: Broken pre-fix mobile capture showing excessive letterboxing.
- `/tmp/bloon-server.log`: Static server output.

## Important Context
- Static server command running in tmux: `cd /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround && PORT=3002 node /home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- Playwright CLI browser is now installed; previous failure `Browser "chromium" is not installed` is resolved.

- Canvas screen mapping at 1440×900: board rect x=25, y=85, w≈1030, h≈802; `view.scale≈0.8587`, `view.oy≈74.7`.

## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand the completed “Bloon Blitz TD” game with new maps and map difficulty categories: Beginner, Intermediate, Advance, Expert.
- Keep the game complete, playable, responsive, and touch-friendly.

## Requirements
- User request: “Add new maps and map difficulty from Beginner, intermediate, advance,expert”
- Original game must remain a complete, playable browser tower defense inspired by “Bloons tower defence 5”.
- Support phones/tablets with usable touch controls and responsive layouts.
- Prefer no external assets/dependencies; use generated Canvas art and Web Audio.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note assumptions when finished.

## Decisions
- Existing game is an original homage titled “Bloon Blitz TD”, not copied Bloons TD assets.
- Vanilla ES modules + Canvas 2D, served as static HTML.
- Existing gameplay: 10 towers × 3 upgrades, 4 targeting modes, 50 authored waves, freeplay, MOAB/BFB bosses, farms, auto-start, speed controls, pause/help/result dialogs.
- Map difficulties should be functional, likely differing by starting lives/cash and map layout—not merely labels.
- Likely implementation: multiple authored map definitions with distinct paths, palettes, decorations, starting resources, and a persistent map-picker UI.

## Work State
### Completed
- Core game implemented in `index.html`, `styles.css`, `js/data.js`, `js/path.js`, `js/audio.js`, `js/game.js`.
- Desktop, tablet, portrait phone, landscape phone, 320px-width, and 1440px layouts browser-tested with no horizontal overflow.
- Mobile touch placement, tower inspector, upgrades, targeting, selling, pause, help modal, wave start, wave completion, and auto-start verified.
- Defeat, victory dialog, restart, freeplay, wave-50 natural victory, and all 10 tower upgrade paths verified.
- Settings persistence verified: sound, auto-start, best wave.
- Added favicon; removed previous 404 console error.
- Added scenic letterbox backdrop, compact landscape modals, safe-area padding, mobile help access, freeplay `/∞` labels, and corrected victory threat card.
- Static server running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- No syntax or browser console errors in final checks.

### Active
- Implement new maps and Beginner/Intermediate/Advance/Expert difficulty selection.
- Relevant existing architecture inspected: path data lives in `js/data.js` as `PATH_ANCHORS`; `js/path.js` builds one active path; `js/game.js` imports that path and uses a static `TREES` array/background.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Add `MAPS` and `MAP_ORDER` definitions with at least four maps, one per difficulty, including path anchors, palette/decor, starting lives/cash, difficulty, and description.
2. Refactor `js/path.js` to support switching the active path, and update `js/game.js` to bind the selected map before `buildBackground()`.
3. Add a map-picker dialog with map cards, miniature path previews, difficulty chips, current-map indicator, and a clickable map badge.
4. Make `buildBackground()`, tree drawing, signs, placement blockers, and possibly ambient decorations map-aware.
5. Persist selected map in `bloon-blitz-settings`; make map changes start a fresh run with map-specific starting resources.
6. Re-test map switching, all difficulties, responsive layouts, wave combat, upgrades, and dialogs; capture final screenshots.
7. Finalize with a concise note of map/difficulty assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: Runtime, rendering, background art, input, UI, dialogs, map integration point.
- `js/data.js`: Tower/bloon/wave data; currently exports `PATH_ANCHORS`; add map definitions here.
- `js/path.js`: Chaikin-smoothed path and placement distance helpers; needs active-map path switching.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layout, board badge, dialogs; add map-picker styling.
- `index.html`: HUD, board badge, dialogs; add map button/dialog structure.
- `js/audio.js`: Synthesized sound effects; likely unchanged.
- `screenshots/`: Ignored QA captures; useful for visual comparison.
- `/tmp/opencode/`: Browser verification scripts, including gameplay, responsive, and wave-50 tests.

## Important Context
- Server command: `PORT=3002 node /home/runner/work/_work/.../scripts/default-start.mjs` in tmux; URL `http://localhost:3002`.
- Debug API: `window.__bloonBlitz` exposes `state`, `beginWave`, `resetGame`, `continueFreeplay`, `damageBloon`, `createBloon`, `selectBuild`, `placeTower`, `addCash`, `completeWave`, `showResult`, `getWave`, `TOWERS`, `BLOONS`.
- Current map is “Monkey Meadow”; board is 1200×760 logical pixels.
- `resetGame()` currently hardcodes `lives: 200`, `cash: 650`; map-specific starts must replace these.
- `buildBackground()` currently uses hardcoded meadow colors, `PATH_POLY`, and static `TREES`; `validPlacement()` also references that same `TREES` array.
- Settings key: `bloon-blitz-settings`; currently persists `sound`, `autoStart`, `best`.
- All project files are currently untracked/uncommitted (`git status` shows `??` for game files).
- Responsive breakpoints include `1180`, `1020`, `860`, `560`, `480`, `390`, `340`, plus compact landscape `max-height: 520px`.
- No blockers currently; browser verification tooling is installed and working.

content.text:
New request: "And add sandbox to spawn bloons and try out monkeys". So add a sandbox mode: maybe button to spawn bloons and try towers. Could be an in-game sandbox panel accessible in map picker or topbar. Users can spawn any bloon, add cash, place monkeys. Need implement.

We have lots to do. Let's capture requirements:
1. Maps/difficulties with track counts 1/2/3/4.
2. Cool maps.
3. MOAB blue, BFB hp 400, spawns 4 MOABs.
4. Sandbox to spawn bloons and try out monkeys.

Need prioritize and implement robustly.

Sandbox design:
- Add "Sandbox" toggle/button, likely in map picker or topbar. Since map picker is being added, could include a "Sandbox" mode button in topbar? Add an icon button `#sandboxBtn` with flask? No icon defined. Could add a text button in the sidebar or map dialog. Best: Add sandbox controls panel on board when sandbox mode is active, triggered by a topbar button with a beaker icon.
- Sandbox mode: unlimited cash, no waves/leaks/defeat, spawn bloons from buttons. Try out monkeys.
- Could be a dialog "Sandbox" with bloon spawn buttons and cash controls. But user wants spawn bloons and try monkeys, so controls need stay accessible while placing. A compact floating "sandbox bar" over board bottom/top.
- Add topbar button `#sandboxBtn` labeled with icon maybe `i-flask` symbol. When active, show a sandbox toolbar above bottom CTA or in sidebar. Simpler: Add a sandbox panel as a collapsible overlay on board top-right? Board top-right currently board tip. Could add a full-width bar under topbar? The sidebar maybe. Better: put sandbox controls in a modal launched by a topbar button, with buttons to spawn each bloon type (red..BFB) and "add $1000", "clear bloons". But modal blocks gameplay. Could keep as non-modal panel in the board.

Alternative: Add a "Sandbox" segment in the map picker dialog with a "Enter sandbox" button. Then when sandbox active, show a bottom sheet with bloon buttons. This is clean:
- Topbar add `#sandboxBtn` icon button (flask). On click toggle sandbox.
- Sandbox toolbar absolute at bottom over board, with a horizontally scrollable row of bloon chips, "Add $2,000", "Clear", and "Exit". On mobile, it can be scrollable.
- Sandbox state:
  - `state.sandbox = true` (not persisted across reload maybe)
  - On enter: pause/clear current run? We should reset game to a clean sandbox with starting resources but unlimited? Could set phase='ready', clear bloons, projectiles, towers? If user wants try monkeys, maybe keep existing towers? Better entering sandbox starts a fresh sandbox run for current map with high cash (e.g. 50,000) and lives 9999, no wave auto-start.
  - Do not begin waves in sandbox; spawn via buttons.
  - `loseLives` returns if sandbox (or lives never decrease).
  - `simulate` shouldn't completeWave/defeat. Since phase 'ready' and we spawn bloons manually, updateBloons runs only in phase 'active' by frame loop. In sandbox, set phase='sandbox' and frame simulation should run. Need modify frame: if phase === 'active' or 'sandbox', simulate. In simulate, skip completeWave if sandbox. Also updateSpawnQueue could be empty, fine.
  - Start button should be disabled/hidden or show "Sandbox"; perhaps hide board CTA and show sandbox toolbar.
  - Spawn buttons call `createBloon(type, 0, lane, track)` with a track selector perhaps cycle. Add "Track [n]" cycling? We can cycle tracks automatically per spawn. That covers all tracks. Buttons for each bloon type, including MOAB/BFB.
  - Add cash button.
  - Clear bloons button.
  - Exit sandbox -> `resetGame()` normal.
  - `state.sandbox` reset false on resetGame? We need `resetGame({sandbox})` option? Simpler separate functions:
    - `enterSandbox()`: set state.sandbox=true; state.phase='sandbox'; lives=Infinity? UI displays maybe 9999. Set `state.lives = 9999; cash=50000`; clear arrays; select nothing; show toolbar; hide CTA; update UI. Set settings? no.
    - `exitSandbox()`: state.sandbox=false; resetGame() (normal current map). Hide toolbar.
    - `resetGame()` should set sandbox false by default? But result restart while sandbox not relevant. Map selection should exit sandbox.
  - `updateStartButton`: if sandbox, hide board CTA? CSS can hide `.board-cta` when body/sandbox class. Add class `is-sandbox` to board? Better toggle `dom.boardCta.hidden = state.sandbox`; but hidden attribute might conflict with CSS. Use `.board-card.sandbox` class and CSS `.board-card.is-sandbox .board-cta{display:none}`.
  - `beginWave` guard if sandbox return. `toggleAutoStart` no effect? Fine.
  - `updateThreatPanel` and UI can show "Sandbox" labels. `updateThreatPanel`: if sandbox, set wave eyebrow 'Sandbox', difficulty 'Free play', etc. Need avoid getWave weird. Add early branch at top.
  - `loseLives` if sandbox: can let bloons leak and disappear without losing lives. Current `updateBloons` leak calls loseLives then filters. Modify loseLives `if (state.sandbox) return;` so no life loss. But `state.stats.leaks` maybe not. Fine.
  - `destroyBloon` cash gain; with 50k cash no issue.
  - `createBloon` path track. In sandbox spawn buttons, choose track cycling `state.sandboxTrack = (state.sandboxTrack+1)%trackCount`. Expose maybe.
  - BFB spawn: ensure `createBloon('bfb')` works. It has hp 400 and children 4 moabs after data change.
  - Add "MOAB" and "BFB" buttons.
  - Sandbox toolbar HTML with `<div class="sandbox-bar" id="sandboxBar" hidden>...`. Buttons generated from BLOON_ORDER. Include label "Spawn". Also track count display.
  - Add money and clear.
  - Also could add tower quick-build "Try monkeys" by normal shop still available. Sidebar remains, good. Explain in toolbar "Unlimited cash · no waves · spawn anything".
  - If sandbox toolbar overlays board bottom, start button hidden. Good.
  - On mobile, toolbar horizontal scroll, maybe two rows; height okay.
  - Topbar sandbox button icon. Add `i-flask` symbol.
  - Sandbox button aria pressed. When active class.
  - Keyboard shortcut maybe `S` toggles sandbox? Could conflict. Add not necessary.
  - Map change exits sandbox.

- Sandbox and result dialog: not relevant.
- `showResult` no.

Need now write code. First path.js refactor. Use `createPath` for previews.

Let's replace path.js fully.
Wrote file successfully: js/path.js
Now modify data.js BFB/MOAB.
Edited js/data.js (1 replacement)

Now modify game.js. Large set of edits. Let's start imports and settings/state.

Imports:
```
import { W,H,..., MAPS, MAP_ORDER, MAP_DIFFICULTIES, getMap } from './data.js';
import { setPaths, getPaths, getPathCount, getPathTotal, pathPoint, distanceToPaths, closestPathInfo, createPath } from './path.js';
```
Note createPath for previews.

Settings map:
```
const parsedMap = MAPS[parsed.map] ? parsed.map : 'meadow';
...
map: parsedMap
```
fallback.

save settings include map.

currentMap and paths init. Need set current map before background built in init. Define `let currentMap = getMap(settings.map); setPaths(currentMap.tracks);` near settings. But settings.map may be invalid. Use getMap.

State add sandbox fields, mapId. ui add map selection.

TREES static remove/replace with helper `mapTrees()` maybe use currentMap.trees.

Let's edit.
Edited js/game.js (1 replacement)
Edited js/game.js (1 replacement)

Now dom additions. Need index.html first or maybe later. Add references to mapBtn, mapName etc, sandbox elements, pause title/copy. We'll add IDs. Let's design index HTML updates: - Add sandbox icon symbol `i-flask` maybe. Simple path: erlenmeyer flask. - Brand subtitle id `brandMapName`. - map badge as button id mapBtn, span id mapName, small id mapDifficulty, add chevron icon. - board tip id already. - pause h2 id pauseTitle, p id pauseCopy. - top actions add sandbox button before help: id sandboxBtn class icon-button sandbox-button title "Sandbox mode". - Add sandbox bar inside board-card after board-cta maybe: ```
SandboxUnlimited cash · spawn anything
``` Could maybe hide board cta while sandbox. Good. - Map dialog after help before result. ``` ...

...

- Position absolute bottom 14 left/right? Board CTA also bottom. In sandbox CTA hidden, toolbar can fill bottom. On desktop maybe a panel height ~120. Use bottom 14 left 14 right 14, display flex column, background dark, backdrop blur, border.
```
.sandbox-bar {
 position:absolute; z-index:5; left:14px; right:14px; bottom:14px;
 display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; padding:10px 12px;
 background: rgba(4,24,16,.86); border... border-radius:16px; backdrop-filter: blur(14px); box-shadow...

.sandbox-bar[hidden]{display:none}
.sandbox-head display flex align...
.sandbox-dot...
.sandbox-bloons display flex gap 5 overflow-x:auto; padding-bottom:2;
.sandbox-bloon ... compact chips
.sandbox-bloon-dot circle with radial gradient
.is-blimp style wider
.sandbox-actions display flex gap; flex-wrap; 
.sandbox-action ...

On mobile, bottom 8, left/right 8, padding 8, head small. At max-width 560 perhaps hide head small. Sandbox toolbar overlay on board with 12 buttons horizontal scroll. Good.

Need map dialog size/scroll. Good.

Need check `color-mix` maybe unsupported in old Chromium test version? It likely supports. Could remove to be safe. It's just glow. Use simple box-shadow with color not needed. We'll leave or remove. Maybe CSS parser accepts unknown function fine.

Need `drawBoardBackdrop` uses frame. Good.

Need update `dom.waveTotal` sandbox. Minor.

Need title/description in index maybe static Monkey Meadow, okay dynamic title set.

Need map picker accessible from board badge, but on small screens map badge small hidden small but still button.

Need sandbox bar `hidden` attribute works CSS.

Need `dom.boardCta.hidden=true` but CSS `.board-cta` might set display flex overriding hidden? `[hidden]` UA style display:none !important? Actually `[hidden]` has `display: none` in UA stylesheet but author `.board-cta{display:flex}` can override because author wins. Since we set hidden attribute, CSS `.board-cta` display:flex would override? The HTML hidden attribute maps to `display:none` in UA style; author styles override UA. So board CTA might remain visible. Need `.board-cta[hidden]{display:none}` CSS. Similarly `.sandbox-bar[hidden]` already. Add. Also `.pause-screen[hidden]` maybe existing? Search.
